# Premier Stone Importers

> Australia's premium supplier of natural and engineered stone for residential and commercial projects.

## About Us

Premier Stone Importers supplies high-quality granite, marble, quartz, quartzite, travertine, and limestone across Australia. We serve homeowners, builders, architects, interior designers, and stonemasons in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, and all Australian cities and regions.

## Contact Information

- Website: https://premierstoneimporters.com.au
- Email: hello@premierstoneimporters.com.au
- WhatsApp: +61 433 575 947
- Service Area: Australia-wide delivery

## Products

We offer over 200 varieties of premium stone:

- **Granite**: Black Galaxy, Steel Grey, Tan Brown, Blue Pearl, Absolute Black, Viscount White (from India, Brazil, Norway)
- **Marble**: Calacatta Gold, Bianco Carrara, Statuario, Emperador Dark (from Italy, Spain)
- **Quartz**: Engineered stone - Iconic White, Calacatta Look, Statuario, Concrete Grey, Midnight Black
- **Quartzite**: Taj Mahal, Sea Pearl, White Macaubas, Azul Macaubas (from Brazil)
- **Travertine**: Ivory Classic, Noce, Walnut, Silver, Gold, Red Persian (from Turkey, Iran)
- **Limestone**: French Beige, Moleanos Blue, Crema Luna, White Limra, Jura Beige (from France, Portugal, Turkey, Germany)

## Applications

Our stone is used for:
- Kitchen benchtops / countertops
- Bathroom vanities
- Wall cladding
- Flooring
- Memorial stones and headstones
- Commercial projects (hotels, offices, retail)

## Service Areas

We deliver Australia-wide including:
- New South Wales (Sydney, Newcastle, Wollongong)
- Victoria (Melbourne, Geelong, Ballarat)
- Queensland (Brisbane, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast)
- Western Australia (Perth, Fremantle)
- South Australia (Adelaide)
- Tasmania (Hobart, Launceston)
- ACT (Canberra)
- Northern Territory (Darwin)
